name: Konga the 2nd
desc:
Konga the 2nd was a member of the Konga lineage and a user of its Slider Style. Konga eventually developed the Karita Plating, a set of leg plating that is, somehow, increase the speed of the wearer to assist in using the Style.

The Plating was later passed to a [fellow member of the Konga lineage](entity:konga_the_third).
